method: Non-blind single-assistant semantic review against the frozen reference definition. Not an independent judge or an automatic grade for new generations.
reference: Reviewed means the record has been checked; it does not by itself mean the record is active or ready.

records.text: A dispatch record is reviewed when its current state is checked to ensure it is accurate and complete before it is used for any further actions.
records.rationale: Explains review as checking or verification.

records.text: A dispatch record is reviewed when its current state is checked to ensure it is accurate and complete before it is acted upon.
records.rationale: Explains review as checking or verification.

records.text: A record is reviewed when its current state is checked and verified against the expected or expected-to-be state before any changes are made.
records.rationale: Explains review as checking or verification.

records.text: A records record is reviewed when its state is updated by the system.
records.rationale: Conflates review with a state update or stale-session refresh.

records.text: A dispatch record is reviewed when it is stale and needs to be updated with the latest information.
records.rationale: Conflates review with a state update or stale-session refresh.

records.text: A dispatch record is reviewed when it is stale and needs to be refreshed to restore its current state.
records.rationale: Conflates review with a state update or stale-session refresh.

records.text: A record is reviewed when its state is checked and verified against the expected state.
records.rationale: Explains review as checking or verification.

records.text: A record is reviewed when its state is updated by records_update_state.
records.rationale: Conflates review with a state update or stale-session refresh.
